name: stophy-sdk
description: Official Stophy SDKs for the YouTube context API for AI agents. One repo, many languages.

scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:py
scripts.generate:check: bun run generate && git diff --exit-code packages/typescript/src/generated
scripts.check:py: uv run --project packages/python ruff check packages/python/src test/python && uv run --project packages/python ruff format --check packages/python/src test/python
scripts.check: bun run check:ts && bun run type-check && bun run check:py
scripts.format:py: uv run --project packages/python ruff check --fix packages/python/src test/python && uv run --project packages/python ruff format packages/python/src test/python
scripts.format: bun run format:ts && bun run format:py
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:py
